description: This Python file contains automated test functions for the device IP configuration and related device information handlers. It uses pytest for test execution and invokes helper functions to interact with device data via rbus_get_data and rbus_set_data. The tests verify correctness of data retrieval and setting for various device IP configuration parameters and other device info attributes.

methods.name: test_DeviceDefault_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests retrieval and setting of device info data elements such as SoftwareVersion, ModelName, FirmwareFilename, and Feature toggles.

methods.name: test_DeviceIP_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests retrieval of various IPv6 and IPv4 configuration data elements related to device IP interface 1, including address settings, prefix, origin, and lifetime parameters.

methods.name: test_DeviceServices_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Checks the number of entries for device services, specifically the STB service count.

methods.name: test_ReverseSSH_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Verifies the reverse SSH configuration status and triggers related reverse SSH commands.
